SQL_STMT_U.val: SELECT psf.id, psf.line_number, psf.purchase_date, psf.small_category_id, sc.name AS small_category_name, psf.product_id, TRIM(psf.item_name) AS product_display_name, psf.origin_id, psf.origin_name, psf.grade_id, psf.transaction_specific_grade_name, psf.class_id, psf.transaction_specific_class_name, psf.per_pack, psf.per_pack_unit_id, psf.per_pack_unit_name, psf.unit_id, psf.unit_name, psf.unit_price_before_pdf_import, psf.unit_price, psf.selling_price, psf.stock_flag FROM purchase_stock_file AS psf LEFT JOIN small_category AS sc ON sc.id = psf.small_category_id WHERE psf.purchase_date BETWEEN DATE ':1' AND DATE ':2' ORDER BY psf.small_category_id, psf.product_id, psf.purchase_date;
